Commentary.Commentary: Right! 196 is what England need. They will need a good opening stand. Banton showed what he is capable of doing int the first washed out game. England will hope similar effort from him and others around him. Pakistan would love a wicket early on to force the hosts on the back foot. Join us on the other side for the run chase.

Bowling from England wasn't up to the mark! None of the bowlers could put any pressure on the Pakistani batters. Saqib Mahmood started well in the first over but they failed to apply pressure from the other end and allowed the Pakistani openers to get to a decent opening stand. Rashid was their pick of the bowlers as he got 2 wickets. Gregory bowled well in his 3 overs but couldn't get any success. Curran and Jordan were taken to the cleaners by Hafeez.

After asked to bat, Pakistan started superbly with the openers adding 72 quickly. Zaman fell for 36 in the 9th over but the skipper Azam continued his charge. He got to his 14th T20I half ton in the process and kept taking Pakistan towards a good score. He holed out to Rashid for 56 but not before showing his class. The experienced duo of Hafeez and Malik then calmly rotated strike in the middle overs.  Hafeez slammed Curran for 18 runs in the 16th over to begin the assault. Malik departed but the hammering from Hafeez continued. The professor got to a fine half ton and  fell in the last over of the innings but not before taking Pakistan to a big huge total.

Fine last over from Curran and he will have to give a pat on the back of Gregory for saving a few at the rope. but Pakistan have got a huge total on the board. A brilliant half-century first by Babar and then a fiery knock from Hafeez has given Pakistan a cushion of a lot of runs to defend.

Only a run of the final ball. Just 7 off it and also a wicket. Restricts Pakistan under 200. Slower short ball outside off, Iftikhar plays it behind point and gets just a single. PAKISTAN 195/4 FROM THEIR 20 OVERS!
Shadab Khan is in! He will only do the running!

OUT! Curran gets a wicket and Hafeez cannot stay unbeaten. Great knock from the experienced man. He has played a great knock. Full on off, Hafeez looks to go over cover but does not time it well and ends up skewing it to Morgan who takes a simple catch.
Once again Gregory is called into action. Full on middle, Hafeez whips it to the right of mid-wicket. Once again Gregory runs and dives on that side. Saves two this time.
Slower ball but a full toss. Iftikhar picks it over square leg. Gregory runs across to his right and does very well as he dives and stops it before the ropes saving three for his side.
Full on off and middle, Iftikhar goes across and wide of mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Fuller on middle, Hafeez glances it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
Tom Curran will bowl the final over! Hasn't been at his best so far. Can he deliver in the last over for England?

DROPPED! Great effort from Morgan and calling it a dropped is a very harsh call but technically it is. Fuller around off, Hafeez clears his front leg and looks to go over cover. Morgan stands at the edge of the circle and jumps. He stretches his right hand. The ball hits his palm but it does not stick in. Good effort from captain Morgan. Single taken.
On middle and leg, Hafeez glances it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Very full on the pads, Iftikhar gets it low on his bat. The ball hits his pads and goes to the leg side. They take a single.
On middle, Hafeez plays it to mid on and gets a single.
Very full on off, Hafeez taps it to the right of Jordan. He jumps and takes the ball. Hafeez comes down a bit for a run. Jordan has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
SIX! Hafeez outsmarts Jordan. Chris bowls a slower ball on a  length outside off. Hafeez picks it early and waits for it before sending it over the cow-corner fence with his pull.

NOT OUT! Safe in the end! Impact outside and the bat is grounded as well. Another excellent ball from Mahmood. A yorker, once again Iftikhar does well to keep it out. This time though take off the for the extra run. Bairstow gets to the ball and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. The ball goes away and they take another run. Morgan takes the DRS and they check the LBW first. The ball is pitched outside leg so safe on LBW front. And he has grounded his bat as well. So, plenty of drama on this ball but all is well for Pakistan in the end.
So no LBW and now time to check the Run Out and even that has not gone England's way as Iftikhar is in.
England have taken a review for LBW.

NOT OUT! The ball hit the turf there. Mahmood though thought this has come off the boot. Full ball around off, Iftikhar does well to keep it out. The ball hits the turf and goes towards the bowler. Mahmood thinks he has taken the catch and appeals. The umpire refers it upstairs.
It is a bump ball wasn't it? Mahmood does not think so and has is asking for a catch. Both umpires get together and the Soft Signal is Not Out!
Full and outside off, Hafeez looks to drive but gets it to long on off the inner half of the bat.
FOUR! Slammed! The assault continues. Shortish and just outside off, Hafeez stays back and hammers it over mid off for a boundary. 9 from the over already.

FOUR! The professor gets to 50 in style! Brilliant knock from him. Full and around off, Hafeez has made his mind already as he moves inside the crease and scoops it over square leg for a boundary. His 12th half-century in T20Is for Hafeez.
Saqib Mahmood to bowl out.
EDGY! Slower ball outside off on a good length, Iftikhar looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. There is a man at third man, so just a single.
Another single! It is right in the yorker slot. Iftikhar punches it to long on for a single. 10 runs and a wicket from the over.
Slower ball around off, Hafeez reads it well and turns it late towards deep square leg for a run.
Good length ball around off, Iftikhar pushes it towards long on to get off the mark on the first ball.
Iftikhar Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Malik finds extra cover. Jordan provides the much-needed wicket for England. It is another fuller ball outside off, pretty similar to the 1st ball of the over. Malik again tries to clear the in-field. However, this time he fails to get under the ball and find enough elevation. The England skipper ad extra cover leaps in the air and takes the catch.
A couple now as this low full toss is flicked wide of the long on fielder. Banton does well to keep it in with a slide. The couple brings 50-run stand between the duo.
WIDE! Jordan goes short but little too short. Wided.

FOUR! Welcome back into the attack says Malik. Jordan starts the new spell by bowling a juicy fuller ball around off, Malik lifts it over mid off to begin the over with a boundary. The stand moves to 47 in no time.
Chris Jordan to try and force something for England.

SIX! Bang! Great way to finish the over. Shorter on off, Hafeez is a good puller of the ball and he has pulled this just over the id-wicket fence for a biggie. Massive over for Pakistan. 23 runs coming off it.
On off, Malik dabs it to third man and is happy to play the second fiddle as he rotates the strike.
Back of a length on off, Hafeez pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Hafeez makes the Free Hit count. Fullish ball on off, Hafeez goes over covers and gets a boundary.
NO BALL AND SIX! Full toss above the waist height. Hafeez smokes his pull over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. To make it worse for Curran there will be a G=Free Hit to follow.

Very good running from the two senior players. Good length ball around off, Shoaib late cuts it wide of third man and look for two straightaway. They go for it. The throw at the keeper's end is a bit wide. Bairstow does not bask himself in glory as he too makes a meal of it allowing Hafeez to make it back  in time. Hafeez gets up and sees the ball has gone away and they take the third as well. Excellent awareness by Hafeez and Malik.
Full and straight on off and middle, Hafeez milks it through mid on for one.
Bowling change! Tom Curran is back on. Can he break this stand?

Short ball which is a lot straighter and offers not much width to the Professor. He pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single. 13 off the over and a much-needed one for Pakistan to gain momentum heading into the final 5.
FOUR! Another flat-bat shot. Slower ball outside off. The ball sits off the surface as Mahmood tries to bowl it short. Hafeez likes it there and flat-bats it over mid off for a boundary.
On the pads, Malik flicks it to the leg side and gets a single.
WIDE! Bouncer bounces too high. It goes over the head of Shoaib Malik who does not even attempt playing that or ducking under it.
Shortish ball on middle, Hafeez looks to pull but does so off the lower half of his willow and gets a single.
FOUR! Tennis swat over the bowler's head. Mahmood would have not liked that one bit. Back of a length delivery on off, Hafeez flat-bats it over the bowler's head and to the long off fence.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Shoaib tucks it to the on side and gets to the other end.
Saqib Mahmood returns. 2-0-15-0 from him so far.
Slower ball outside off, Hafeez looks to play the premeditated paddle but he misses. Tidy over just 6 off it. 10 off the last 2.
Length ball around off, Hafeez late cuts it but finds backward point.
Just over mid on. Length ball on off, Gregory rolled his fingers on this one. Hafeez pulls it but does not time it well. Gets enough to get it over the man at mid on  for a couple.
Length ball around off, Malik runs it down to third man for one.
Good length delivery on off, Shoaib defends it.
Length ball on off, Hafeez nudges it to point for one.

WIDE! False start to the over for Gregory. He bowls one down the leg side, Malik looks to flick but misses. Bairstow dives to his left and fails to take it cleanly allowing them to cross-over as well.
Lewis Gregory is back! 2-0-16-0 from him so far.
Shortish and around off, forced towards long on for a single by Malik to open his account. 4 runs and a wicket from the over. Rashid ends his spell with 2 for 32.
Flatter and just outside off, pushed toward point.
Two of the most experienced batters now at the crease as Shoaib Malik joins Mohammad Hafeez.

OUT! CAUGHT! Babar holes out! He is livid with himself. Rashid gets the big wicket. He bowls another short ball on middle, Babar rocks back again and goes for the pull. This time the ball bounces a bit extra and Babar fails to time it at all. He finds Billings in the deep. A simple catch and he swallows it. Brilliant knock from the Pakistani skipper comes to an end.
Short again, pulled to long on for a single.
Short and around middle, Babar pulls it to deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Full and around middle, flicked to long on for a run.
Good length ball on off, Babar cuts it to point.
Short ball but this one falls down. Hafeez looks to pull but takes his eyes off. The ball hits the glove and the body to go behind on the leg side for one.
Slower ball around off, Babar cuts it to point and gets one.

Another attempted pull but this one it nowhere near the middle. Mahmood hits the deck hard around off, Hafeez looks to pull it goes off the upper half and luckily it is away from the man in the deep and gets a single.
SIX! The Professor brings goes past 2000 T20I runs in style. Shorter on middle and off, Hafeez picks it up nicely and pulls it right off the meat and over backward square leg fence for half a dozen.
Good length ball on off, Babar guides it to third man and gets a single.
Saqib Mahmood is back for his 2nd over.
Floated on middle and leg, BA milks it to long on and keeps the strike.
Tossed up on off, it is overpitched. Hafeez fails to make the most of it and just chips it over cover for one.
Short on middle and off, Babar pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets a boundary.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR THE SKIPPER! Babar is the number 1 ranked batsman in the world in T20Is and he has shown why. Great knock from the skipper and he is literally leading from the front. Tossed up on off, Babar plays his glamorous cover drive and gets a boundary to bring up his 14th T20I fifty.
FOUR! The skipper moves to 47 now. Short on off, Babar pulls it through mid-wicket and gets another boundary.
Shorter on off, Hafeez punches it to sweeper cover and gets a single.
On the pads, Hafeez turns it to the leg side and keeps the strike. 87 for 1 at the halfway mark.
FOUR LEG BYES! Slower ball on the body, Hafeez looks to pull but misses. The ball clips his body and goes fine and away from diving Bairstow and runs away to the fine leg fence.
Length ball on off, Babar dabs it to third man and gets a single.
On the pads, Hafeez flicks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Now follows the boundary with a single towards mid-wicket. Clever batting.
FOUR! Deft from Babar. Very well played. Good length ball around off, Babar waits for it and just uses the pace of the ball and runs it down fine at third man and gets a boundary.
Single to end an eventful over from Rashid. Tossed up on middle, Babar milks it to long on and keeps the strike.
Shorter on middle, Hafeez gets on his back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single  to get off the market.
On the pads, Babar flicks it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Mohammad Hafeez is in at no. 3.

OUT! Caught! Rashid has the last laugh! Zaman departs and England get their first wicket of the game. A very good opening stand comes to an end. Smartly bowled from Rashid. He bowls it quicker on off, Zaman once again looks to heave it over mid-wicket but this one comes quicker and he does not get under it as well as he would have wanted. He gets a lot of height on it but it goes in front of long on. Tom Banton comes in and keeps his eyes on the ball to take the swirler. Not an easy one but well done by Banton.
Corrects his line and length and tosses it up on off. Fakhar blocks it.

SIX! That was six the moment it left the bat! It is a big ground but this would have been a six anywhere in the world. Googly from Rashid but right in the slot on middle and leg. Fakhar smokes it over mid-wicket for a biggie.

Single to end the over! Decent one from Lewis. Went for a boundary on the first ball then another 4 on the next 5 balls.  Good length ball on middle, Zaman plays it towards mid on and keeps the strike for the next over.
Slower fuller ball around off, Babar reads it well and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and around off, Babar drives it well but finds Ali at mid off. Zaman was off for the run but Babar shouts a loud no.
Shortish and on middle, Zaman pulls it to long on for a single.
On the pads, this one is worked towards fine leg for a run. Babar wanted the second but Zaman refused.
FOUR! Hammered! Full and wide outside off, Babar lofts it over mid off to bag another boundary. Runs coming thick and fast for Pakistan now.
Lewis Gregory comes into the attack.
On the pads, Babar turns it to the on side and keeps the strike.
FOUR! Nicley played and placed! Short on off, Babar gets on his back foot and pulls it between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Babar is quick to get back in. Good work from Bairstow but Babar is back in. Nicely bowled by Rashid. He gives this air on off and the ball drifts away beautifully beating Babar's drive. He drags his foot outside the crease. Bairstow is quick to whip off the bails but Babar is quicker to drag is foot back in.
Tossed up on off, Fakhar milks it to long off for one.
This time Babar manages to flick and get to the other end.
Appeal but sliding down leg. Darted on leg but it keeps going straight. Babar looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a hopeful appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Time for Adil Rashid to roll his arms.
On the pads again, Babar flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a single. End of the Powerplay and a good one for Pakistan. They are 51 after 6 overs.
50 up for Pakistan. Good start this for the tourists. On the pads, Babar flicks it to the leg side and gets a couple to bring up the 50-run opening stand.
Follows the boundary with a single on the off side.

FOUR! Well played in the end by Fakhar. Curran manages to extract some extra bounce off the surface. Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, the ball bounces off the surface. Zaman is taken by surprise but manages to hit it between the wide slip and keeper for a boundary.
On off, Babar plays it to point and gets to the other end.
On the pads, Babar flicks it but straight to mid-wicket.
Another slower one around off, Babar guides it to third man and keeps the strike. Another excellent overs for Pakistan, 11 from it.
Short ball, Fakhar pulls it to backward square leg and gets a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the keeper's end. Would have been close had he hit.
FOUR! Good shot! Not a bad ball from Jordan. He bowls it very full, almost a yorker but Fakhar manages to drive it past mid off and get a boundary.
Off-cutter and bouncer. Babar pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Better ball! Good length ball around off, slightly slower. Babar looks to drive but misses.

FOUR! Crunching shot! Jordan is guilty of giving width to Babar outside off. The class of the Pakistan skipper is such that if you bowl a bad ball then just pray that you are not punished because he will punish you. Length ball outside off, Babar crunches it through cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over. Slower short ball from Curran, Fakhar waits and then pulls it through the vacant square leg region for a boundary.
On the pads, this time Babar turns it to square leg and gets a single.
On the pads, Babar flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Nothing off the Free Hit. Good length ball around off, Babar looks to flat-bat it over cover but does not connect well and hits it to the man inside the circle.
NO BALL! Curran has disturbed the stumps in his followthrough. It is down the leg side, Babar looks to flick but misses.. Free Hit to follow.
Nicely disguised. Curran bowls a slower one at 70 mph. It is on a length, Babar looks to pull but is way too early and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tom Curran starts with a length ball outside off, Fakhar punches it with minimum to no foot movement through cover for a couple.
Another change! Morgan is shuffling the bowlers already. Time for Tom Curran to bowl now.
Single to end. Another good over for Pakistan as they get 9 from it. The last ball is short and on middle, Zaman pulls but finds the deep square leg fielder.
Slower delivery on middle and leg, Babar tucks it towards fine leg to get to the other end.
Shortish and around off, Babar is on the back foot to punch it wide of the third man fielder. A couple taken before Rashid can get around.
Full and on middle, flicked to long on for a run.
Where's the ball? Jordan was in his stride but the ball popped out of his hand there.
Full and around off, Zaman pushes it towards point and thinks for a single but is sent back by the skipper.
FOUR! Poor start from Jordan. Full toss outside off, Fakhar creams it through the cover region to get another boundary.
Chris Jordan is on now!
Tossed up on off, Zaman strokes it through mid off and keeps the strike. 10 from the over.
FOUR! Fakhar gets his first boundary of the game. Short and wide outside off, Fakhar gets on his back foot and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Babar milks it towards mid on and gets a single.
Off spinner on middle, Babar glances it wide of mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Fakhar is off the mark! On the pads, Zaman glances it to the leg side and takes a single.
Moeen starts with a shorter delivery around off, Babar pulls it with the spin. There is a man at deep mid-wicket so just a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? Spin or Pace? Spin it is as Moeen Ali will partner Mahmood.
Good length ball around off, Fakhar taps it behind the stumps on the off side and looks for a quick run but Babar is quick to turn it down.
Length ball around off, Fakhar gets bat on ball for the first time as he blocks it.

Appeal but turned down. Good length ball pitching around leg, Fakhar looks to flick but misses. There is an appeal but the umpire turns it down. No review from Morgan either. Looked to be pitching outside leg and that is the case as confirmed by Ball Tracker later on.
Length ball on the pads, Babar tucks it to the on side and gets to the other end.
Good length ball on off, Babar pushes it to cover.

FOUR! The skipper and Pakistan are up and running with a boundary! Mahmood starts with a short ball around off. Babar is quick to get on his back foot and pulls it in front of square. The fielder gives it a chase but the ball just about beats him to the fence.  Delightful start for the tourists.

Right! We are ready for the action! The umpires stride out to the middle and the English players follow them. Skipper Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman are the two openers for Pakistan. Saqib Mahmood will start for England. Here we go...

Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam admits that had they won the toss we would have bowled first as they did well with the ball in the last game but says, unfortunately, they lost the toss and have to bat now. Informs they are unchanged. Says they gave rest to Wahab Riaz due to the team combination as they wanted to play a right-arm seemer.

England skipper Eoin Morgan says that the wicket looks good but feels it will be a bit slower. Confirms they are playing with the same XI. Tells that Jordan is back ahead of the time. Feels he is one of the most-sought T20 bowlers all over the world and is happy to have him in the team.
Pakistan (Playing XI): Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Iftikhar Ahmed, Shadab Khan, Imad Wasim, Mohammad Amir, Haris Rauf, Shaheen Afridi
England (Playing XI): Tom Banton, Jonny Bairstow (WK), Dawid Malan, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Billings, Moeen Ali, Lewis Gregory, Tom Curran, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Saqib Mahmood
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of England. THEY WILL BOWL FIRST!

Hello and welcome to one and all for the 2nd T20I game between England and Pakistan. After rain played the spoilsport in the first encounter of the 3-match series, we try again. The venue is the same as the first T20I. However, the good news today is that the forecast is pretty good for the entire day and we shouldn't be getting any rain. So, fingers crossed for the same. Don't think there will be any changes in the teams provided it was a washout in the 1st game. So, be with us to find that out along with the toss update.
